description: This file defines a database migration class for upgrading the OrangeHRM system to version 5.3.0. It includes methods for modifying database schema, updating translation strings, converting times to UTC, and cleaning up legacy configurations.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Installer\Migration\V5_3_0\Migration
classes.description: Migration class responsible for applying database schema changes, data updates, and cleanup tasks to upgrade OrangeHRM to version 5.3.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Main method executing all upgrade steps such as inserting permissions, updating language strings, modifying tables, and cleaning up configs.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

methods.name: createColumnToStoreBuzzOriginalVideoLink
methods.description: Adds a new column to store original video links and migrates existing link data.

methods.name: modifyBuzzTables
methods.description: Drops and alters existing tables and columns related to the Buzz feature, and manages foreign key constraints.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign keys that conflict with constraints on 'hs_hr_employee' table.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Attempts to drop conflicting foreign key constraints.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Re-adds foreign keys that were dropped due to conflicts.

methods.name: changeBuzzTablesDateTimeColumnsAsNotNull
methods.description: Alter columns in Buzz tables to set specific datetime columns as NOT NULL.

methods.name: convertBuzzCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts comment time fields in the Buzz comments table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzLikeOnCommentTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts like time fields in the Buzz like on comment table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzLikeOnShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts like time fields in the Buzz like on share table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzPostTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts post time fields in the Buzz post table to UTC.

methods.name: convertBuzzShareTableTimesToUTC
methods.description: Converts share time fields in the Buzz share table to UTC.

methods.name: getTableRecordCount
methods.description: Fetches the total number of records in a specified table.

methods.name: convertServerTimeToUTCTime
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object from server timezone to UTC.

methods.name: getUTCTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the UTC timezone object, caching it for reuse.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Provides an instance of LangStringHelper, initializing if necessary.
